name: Cassava
note: DRAFT for the hackathon. Must be reviewed by a CARI / MOA agronomist before use with farmers.

sms.en: CASSAVA: Prepare mounds or ridges. Choose stems only from healthy plants with no yellow twisted leaves. Dial *347# for help
CASSAVA: Plant 25 cm cuttings at an angle, about 1 m apart. Plant at the start of the rains. Dial *347# for help
CASSAVA: Keep the field clean of weeds until the leaves cover the ground. Report yellow twisted leaves: *347# option 4
CASSAVA: Pull out and burn plants with yellow twisted leaves so the sickness does not spread. Dial *347# for help
CASSAVA: Harvest as you need it. Process into gari or fufu within 2 days so it does not spoil. *347# for prices
